propositions: The enrich drain gate check scans every ticket directory and calls reduce_ticket on each, resulting in ~24,000 metadata syscalls per write, causing 486-740 ms latency against a 20 ms budget

The gate runs on every rebar write in every agent process, and concurrent writes cause positive feedback contention on the kernel vnode cache, producing non-linear latency scaling up to 3.6x slower with concurrent gate activity
The budget warning fires on 100% of writes to stores with >150 tickets, making it an uninformative noise signal instead of alerting to genuine drain failures
A marker at .rebar/enrich-gate.json recording next_eligible_ns allows pending_enrichment to return immediately when the store is provably quiet, making the gate O(1) instead of O(ticket-count)
The marker self-heals via TTL expiration, queue append invalidation, and graceful degradation to full scan on any marker corruption or absence
